output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS german_revenue_q4_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
  AND o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Revenue is defined by fct_orders.is_revenue = true and measured as net_revenue. I joined orders to dim_customers to filter on country = 'Germany' and restricted order_date to Q4 2025 (1 Oct to 31 Dec 2025), then summed net_revenue and rounded to 2 decimals. I have not run the query, so the exact country label ('Germany') is assumed to match the stored values.
